title: nepeta argolica subsp. vourinensis
intro: Nepeta argolica subsp. vourinensis, commonly known as Greek catmint, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the mint family, Lamiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Nepeta argolica subsp. vourinensis include its ability to act as a spasmolytic, relaxing the muscles and reducing spasms, as well as its sedative and anxiolytic effects, which may help to promote relaxation and reduce anxiety. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, particularly nepetalactone, which is responsible for its unique fragrance and therapeutic properties.
